result.title: Adversarial Post-Training of Foundation Models for High-Frequency Trading
result.comment: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), Milan, Italy. 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/alexandre-bismuth/WGAN-Post-Training
result.summary: While autoregressive foundation models trained on limit order book (LOB) data show state-of-the-art performance for market simulation, pre-training with cross-entropy neither penalizes the compounding of sampling errors over free-running rollouts nor targets desired market properties. We introduce a post-training method for LOB foundation models using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (GAN) objective. A critic, trained online on rollouts through the true, non-differentiable matching engine, guides updates from evolution strategies over rank-4 LoRA perturbations of the pre-trained generator, under a KL trust region. For efficiency, we use EGGROLL (Evolution Guided GeneRal Optimisation via Low-rank Learning), a memory-efficient variant of evolution strategies. On a held-out panel, adversarial post-training improves LOB-Bench realism by 17.6% (WS-21) and 17.0% (Mean-$L_1$), while selection-matched random-perturbation and compute-matched continued-pre-training controls yield no improvement. Post-training is thus a necessary stage that more pre-training does not replace. Per-position divergence measurements show that it slows error accumulation over 500-message rollouts from $3.1\times$ to $2.3\times$. Adversarial post-training is also inexpensive, requiring under 50M training tokens and 12 GPU-hours per seed, three orders of magnitude below the 48B-token pre-training budget. Ablations over critic inputs, optimizers, and the population-rollout trade-off, together with an analysis of reward hacking, yield practical design guidelines for adversarial post-training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为限价单簿（LOB）基础模型提出对抗式后训练：以 Wasserstein GAN 形式，用经过真实匹配引擎的 rollout 在线训练 critic，并借 EGGROLL 演化策略对 rank-4 LoRA 扰动更新生成器，在 KL 信赖域下提升市场模拟的真实性与长时间 rollout 的误差累积表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用对抗 critic 直接监督自由运行 rollout、以缓解采样误差累积的思路，可能为 LVR 中长程 latent 轨迹训练、逐步贡献分配与误差累积诊断提供可核查的方法线索；跨领域迁移尚未验证，需较多核查。
